scholarships.title: University of Auckland Top Achiever Scholarship

existing.description: The University of Auckland Top Achiever Scholarship is an annual University of Auckland award that recognises and rewards students with excellent academic records and demonstrated leadership potential enrolling full-time in the first year of an undergraduate degree. Up to 250 awards are made each year, each worth up to $27,000 in total, comprising one year of catered accommodation in a University of Auckland Hall of Residence plus $5,000. Applications for the 2027 round opened on 20 May 2026 and closed at midday on 12 August 2026.
eligibility: Enrolling full-time in the first year of an undergraduate degree programme
Must meet the criteria in the published scholarship regulations
existing.eligibility_summary: Applicants must be enrolling full-time in the first year of an undergraduate degree programme at the University of Auckland and must have an excellent academic record and demonstrated leadership potential. The published regulations set the detailed criteria.
benefits: One year of catered accommodation in a University of Auckland Hall of Residence
coverage: One year of catered accommodation in a Waipapa Taumata Rau, University of Auckland Hall of Residence
requirements: Read the published scholarship regulations carefully before applying, as the University advises
Apply within the published opening and closing window
application_method: Online application via the University of Auckland's Find a scholarship portal
existing.selection_notes: The University states 'Scholarship applications will usually open around six weeks before the closing date' and advises reading the regulations to confirm eligibility before applying.
existing.best_fit: High-achieving school leavers with strong leadership records entering the first year of a University of Auckland undergraduate degree.
existing.notes: Tenure is one year. Between 250 awards are offered annually. Enquiries about a particular scholarship should include the exact name and be marked urgent if the closing date is within three days.
existing.application_period: Annual. 2027 round: 20 May 2026 to 12 August 2026 at midday. The University notes applications 'will usually open around six weeks before the closing date'.
existing.deadline_display: Opening date 20 May 2026; closing date 12 August 2026 at midday. The page states 'Application status: Not currently open for applications'. The next round's dates are not published.

scholarships.title: University of Auckland Vaka Moana Scholarship

existing.description: The University of Auckland Vaka Moana Scholarship supports Indigenous Pacific students enrolling in their first year of undergraduate study at the University of Auckland. It is offered annually and is worth up to $24,000, comprising one year of catered accommodation in a University of Auckland Hall of Residence plus a laptop. Applications for the 2027 round opened on 20 May 2026 and closed at midday on 12 August 2026.
eligibility: Be enrolling in the first year of undergraduate study at the University of Auckland
Must meet the criteria in the published scholarship regulations
existing.eligibility_summary: Applicants must be Indigenous Pacific students enrolling in their first year of undergraduate study at the University of Auckland. The published regulations set the detailed criteria.
benefits: One year of catered accommodation in a University of Auckland Hall of Residence
coverage: One year of catered accommodation in a Waipapa Taumata Rau, University of Auckland Hall of Residence
requirements: Read the published scholarship regulations carefully before applying, as the University advises
Apply within the published opening and closing window

existing.selection_notes: The University states 'Scholarship applications will usually open around six weeks before the closing date' and advises reading the regulations to confirm eligibility before applying. The number on offer is published only as 'Varies'.
